Open-Meteo supplies the continuous gridded surface record, pressure-level model fields, synoptic grid, land fields and ERA5 climate archive. Standard normals use 1991-2020; the recent comparison retains the prior 10 years and is stored in baseline_metrics.csv. Data completeness check passed with 72/72 expected local-period hours. Hungary-wide electricity context from Energy-Charts (primarily ENTSO-E data). Model-derived atmospheric profile near Debrecen; it is not an observed radiosonde. Radar archive unavailable: Failed to fetch https://odp.met.hu/weather/radar/composite/nc/refl2D/ after 4 attempts: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='odp.met.hu', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /weather/radar/composite/nc/refl2D/ (Caused by NewConnectionError('<urllib3.connection.HTTPSConnection object at 0x0000023E6C891E70>: Failed to establish a new connection: [WinError 10013] A szoftvercsatornához a hozzáférési engedélyeket megsértő módon történt hozzáférés')) HungaroMet LINET events within 150 km of Debrecen. Detected 25 lightning events in the reporting period. No Meteosat frames were available in the provider's rolling archive. First failure: AirmassRGB: Failed to fetch https://odp.met.hu/weather/satellite/MSG/png/AirmassRGB/ after 4 attempts: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='odp.met.hu', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /weather/satellite/MSG/png/AirmassRGB/ (Caused by NewConnectionError('<urllib3.connection.HTTPSConnection object at 0x0000023E6CCE1720>: Failed to establish a new connection: [WinError 10013] A szoftvercsatornához a hozzáférési engedélyeket megsértő módon történt hozzáférés')) Frontal passages are objective candidates based on three-hour pressure, temperature, wind and precipitation changes. A pressure, precipitation or strong-gust anchor is required to suppress ordinary diurnal temperature and wind cycles. The detector identifies local passage signatures; it does not replace a manually analysed synoptic front. Phenomena are deterministic candidates based on explicit thresholds; they are not manually quality-controlled reports. Observed station evidence is preferred, with gridded or model-derived evidence identified when observations are unavailable. Analogs are selected from 15 years of ERA5 daily data within +/-45 calendar days. Similarity uses standardized temperature, precipitation, wind, radiation, cloud and pressure; it is descriptive rather than predictive. Synoptic fields are model analyses from Open-Meteo Historical Forecast data. Frames are sampled every 6 hours on a 1-degree Central European grid. Vorticity, thermal advection and kinematic frontogenesis are finite-difference diagnostics derived on the reporting grid. A true 2-PVU dynamical-tropopause surface is not exposed by the no-secret provider and is not approximated. Standard anomalies use 30 same-calendar ERA5 periods from 1991-2020. Full-record percentiles use 36 same-calendar periods from 1990-2025. The recent-climate comparison uses 10 periods and remains separate from the WMO standard-normal window. Rolling soil, VPD and ET0 fields use Open-Meteo Historical Weather best-match gridded data, not station measurements. The 1991-2020 water-balance reference is fixed to ERA5; the rolling best-match series can use newer IFS and ERA5/ERA5-Land inputs. Water balance is precipitation minus FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration and does not include runoff or irrigation. Dry/wet context uses the 1991-2020 distribution of same-calendar water-balance windows. PV yield models a south-facing 35-degree fixed array per installed kWp using plane-of-array irradiance and cell-temperature derating. Wind output uses observed/modelled 100 m wind, moist-air density correction, and a generic 3/12/25 m/s cut-in/rated/cut-out power curve. These are reference-system weather yields, not metered production or a forecast. pages.title: About | Atlas
pages.visible_text: Debrecen, Hungary - 2026-08-01 About This Report What is observed, what is model-derived, and when the daily publication updates. Publication The public report is rebuilt daily from the last complete Europe/Budapest calendar day. It uses the same deterministic calculations as the meteorological analysis, with shorter explanations and fewer diagnostics. Evidence HungaroMet station, radar, LINET and Meteosat products are observational or remotely sensed. Open-Meteo supplies continuous gridded surface fields, model pressure levels and ERA5 climate fields. Optional-source failures are reported as unavailable, never treated as observed zeroes. Climate references "Normal" means the 1991-2020 ERA5 standard reference. The recent-decade comparison and full-record percentile are shown separately.
